'''1997 Calamari Regionals (Sydney)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Calamari region (Australia, New Zealand).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="nf97cal">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/calamariqualifier.html Calamari I Star Wars CCG Qualifier Results], Kendrick Summers, Decipher NewsFlash (6 June 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607091948/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/calamariqualifier.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Calamari)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 31 May 1997
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Players:''' 19
